concerns.text: Tasks reference `specs/001-ecotourism-regeneration/...` (e.g. T002 'Validate each time-series point against `specs/.../contracts/timeseries.schema.yaml`', T009/T010 write to `specs/001-ecotourism-regeneration/research.md`), but the actual spec directory is `specs/001-investigating-the-potential-benefits-of/` (contracts live there). An implementer following the literal path will not find the schema files or a writable spec dir — fix the canonical directory path in every task.

T004 requires fitting a 'hierarchical non-linear asymptotic model (logistic/Gompertz) ... borrowing strength across sites', but the pinned dependency list in T001 (`statsmodels`, `scikit-learn`, etc.) contains no library capable of hierarchical non-linear mixed-effects fitting. The task as specified is not executable with the declared toolchain — either add a feasible dependency (e.g. `scipy.optimize` with a documented hierarchical scheme) or make the per-site non-linear fit + linear fallback the documented design.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs constitution Principles III/VII
concerns.text: The constitution requires every raw Landsat scene and every file under `data/` to be checksummed with hashes recorded in the state YAML `artifact_hashes` map, but no task produces or verifies checksums. T002/T005 download and process scenes without any checksum deliverable — add a checksumming step with a named output (e.g. `data/raw/landsat/checksums.json`) and verification.

T001 is too coarse for deterministic execution: it bundles directory scaffolding, requirements pinning, WDPA fetch, ecotourism metadata schema, fail-loud error handling, query logging, and quickstart documentation into one task with four distinct verification clauses. Flag for atomization into separate fetch/scaffold/document tasks.

T002 and T003 each cover multiple deliverables (Landsat download + NDVI pipeline + QA masking + schema validation + unit tests; climate fetch + pairing + proxy substitution + end-to-end run). Each should be split so individual verifications map to single deliverables.

SC-002's '≥90% of test cases' is operationalized as 'a convergence check on the actual processed dataset (or a 10-pair subset)' — the population over which 90% is measured is ambiguous, making the verification non-deterministic. Specify exactly what counts as a test case (e.g. per-pair model fits or per sensitivity configuration) and which population the 90% applies to.

T008 promises 'coefficients, CIs' in `regression_coefficients`, but the FinalReport contract defines that field as a bare dict of point estimates with no CI structure. The Pydantic validation T008 names as its verification cannot confirm the CI requirement — either extend the contract or state the CI encoding (e.g. nested {coef, ci_lower, ci_upper}).
T009's deliverable path is ambiguous: 'research.md (or results.md)'. Name one concrete file so the verification ('document exists') is deterministic.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 Verification vs plan.md Project Structure
concerns.text: T001 writes site metadata to `data/raw/site_coordinates.csv` while plan.md's structure lists `data/processed/site_metadata.csv`; pick one canonical path so downstream tasks (T002 reads 'site coordinates from T001') resolve unambiguously.
